records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Quartz Systems!
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Your workspace for Quartz Systems is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project and no key milestone (stall_reasons). Only engagement signal is 1 invite sent; Jules never replied to the welcome email [email:f3d328b1] and no-showed the welcome call [calendar:338c88fa]. No tickets, no questions — silence plus a no-show suggests low unaided odds within the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Sorry we missed each other last week — easy to let a new tool slide when the week fills up.

I saw an invite go out to a teammate, which is a good start. The next step that makes Wrenfield click is a first real project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'll walk through setting up one real project with you and answer anything about how Quartz Systems should structure things.

Best,
Chidi
